title: Project Manager’s “Remove Missing” only works according to conditions at startup
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.beta4.official [2d113cc22]

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Hi,

It seems the Project Manager checks for missing projects only once on startup and enables the “Remove Missing” button accordingly.

If you’re cleaning house and manually deleting project files from disk while the Project Manager is open (afaik, the Manager doesn’t have “remove from list and disk“), you can’t use the button until you re-open the Project Manager. It seems reasonable to delete projects while the Manager is running, because it’s a quick way to get to the project files in the first place.

Not a big issue by any stretch, but I feel like the button should just always work, since it’s idempotent anyway. Alternative ideads:
* The Manager could check for missing projects every time it regains focus, or something.
* The Remove Missing button could turn into “Check for missing projects” instead of going disabled.

Cheers

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Project Manager.
2. From outside the Project Manager, delete or rename one of the project directories listed.
3. Back in the Project Manager, “Remove Missing” is disabled.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Issue isn’t project specific.
